paper_title: RedWhale An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining
caption: : Comparison of trainable parameters between Ex1 and Ex2 in Embedding and LM Head training.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the proportion of trainable and frozen parameters for two experiments, labeled Ex1 and Ex2, during Embedding and LM Head training. The horizontal axis represents the experiment labels, Ex1 and Ex2, listed in an unspecified order. The vertical axis, labeled “Percentage (%)”, has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick marks at intervals of 10. Two bars are present for each experiment, visually arranged side-by-side. Each experiment has one blue bar representing “Trainable (%)” and one lavender bar representing “Frozen (%)”. For Ex1, the blue “Trainable” bar extends to approximately 96.59%, while the lavender “Frozen” bar extends to approximately 3.41%. For Ex2, the blue “Trainable” bar extends to approximately 98.71%, while the lavender “Frozen” bar extends to approximately 1.29%. No bars appear to be specifically emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
